statement: The closest work explicitly claims a fair KGModel-vs-CGModel comparison by holding backbone, fine-tuning configuration, LoRA setup, optimizer, sequence length, batch size, epochs and learning-rate schedule fixed, and asserts that the only difference is the type of QA supervision used in training.

evidence.quote: For a fair comparison, all four models are initialized from the same base model and trained using the same fine-tuning configuration, LoRA setup, optimizer, sequence length, batch size, number of epochs, and learning-rate schedule. The only difference between KGModel and CGModel is the type of QA supervision used during training.
